# Android Solid Services

> The Solid SDK for Android — sign in once through Solid Share, and reach the user's pod from any app with a scoped grant.

Android Solid Services is the Solid SDK for Android. Solid Share holds the user's pod accounts; every other app reaches those pods through it over AIDL, with a grant the user scoped and without handling a credential.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://androidsolidservices.erfangholami.com/0.8/start/quickstart/index.md)
